name: F1 Live Standings
description: Formula 1 on the board: the live grid of every session, practice and qualifying timesheets included (pushed by the FastF1 sidecar), the driver championship and the next race and session (Jolpica). Build your own layout from the variables.
author: Alvin To

top_n.title: Top N
top_n.description: The live grid on the board is refreshed when the order of the first N drivers changes (1-20), and in practice and qualifying also when the fastest lap changes. Lap, time left and track status always update.

race_status.description: LIVE during any session (practice, qualifying, sprint, race), NO DATA when the live feed stops for 60 s, FINISHED for up to 2 h after the flag (until the next session goes live), else NEXT RACE

session.description: The session shown: FP1, FP2, FP3, SQ, SPRINT, Q or RACE (empty when race_status is NEXT RACE)

session_part.description: Qualifying part: Q1, Q2, Q3 (SQ1-SQ3 in sprint qualifying); empty otherwise

time_left.description: Practice and qualifying: session clock remaining, M:SS or MM:SS (last known during NO DATA; empty otherwise)

lap.description: Race and sprint: current lap (last known during NO DATA; empty otherwise)

total_laps.description: Race and sprint: scheduled laps (empty otherwise)

track_status.description: GREEN, YELLOW, SC, VSC or RED (empty outside a session)

next_race.description: Next Grand Prix, short name (empty when the season is over)

next_race_time.description: Start of the next Grand Prix in FiestaBoard's timezone (empty when the season is over)

next_session.description: Next session to start: FP1, FP2, FP3, SQ, SPRINT, Q or RACE (empty when none is left)

next_session_time.description: Start of the next session in FiestaBoard's timezone (empty when none is left)
